descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
There are over 28 different experiences based on the four paths of Bushido, Tea Ceremony, Flower Arrangement, and Calligraphy!
All activities are certified with ranks and titles!
 We have a wide variety of activities, from mindfulness activities like Samurai, Ninja, Tea Ceremony, Flower Arrangement, Kanji, Zazen, Hot Springs, and Sushi!
 We also have a wide variety of games and activities, from creative activities that express the soul to traditional Japanese games!
[media]
Remove the tarnish from the sword and polish and align your mind as well
[media]
Everyone is equal inside the tea room Regardless of rank, everyone should enter with their heads bowed
[media]
Arrange flowers of each season freely, and create whatever your heart desires, 
such as Chinese characters in ink paintings
[media]
Beyond the 28+ activities, finding all the hidden “kokeshi”dolls will unlock a door to a new world
